subject: Middlebury Sophomore, Hungry to Learn
body:
Hi Simon,

I'm Max, 20, ambitious, curious about entrepreneurship, and a current Midd kid. Treating a $20k vector search bill as an architecture problem rather than a reason to shelve the feature is the whole company.

I'm building an AI teaching assistant over a department's worth of course material, big corpus, almost no query volume, no budget, exactly the shape that gets shelved. I'd love to know what that cost has to fall to before retrieval stops being a line item someone defends. If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max

subject: Middlebury Sophomore, Hungry to Learn
body:
Hi Zach,

I'm Max, 20, ambitious, curious about entrepreneurship, and a current Midd kid. Leaving software at that scale for a puck you cross the room to tap is betting friction is the moat.

I'm building an AI teaching assistant inside the classes you said you weren't getting much from, so I took the other side of your bet. I'd love to know whether hardware changed what you decide to build, or only how long it takes to find out you were wrong. If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max
